verses.text: A song of ascents. Of David. Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!

segments.text: A song of ascents. Of David. Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!

verses.text: It is like fine oil on the head, running down on the beard, running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes.

segments.text: It is like fine oil on the head, running down on the beard, running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes.

verses.text: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.

segments.text: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.
